reviewer: independent read-only subagent (Explore type, fresh context, model opus); read the tool scripts, SKILL.md, tests, design and make_tasks; probed scenarios in a temp folder

findings.finding: A story can reach PASS on evidence it wrote itself: any manifest check with exit 0 and an existing log (even not required, any size, any cmd) and any {type:'human', by:<anything>} count as evidence (verify.mjs:129-134). Probe: an AC backed only by a made-up check whose log was batch.json came out PASS.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed

findings.finding: log_path is not limited to the batch folder (absolute or ../ paths accepted; any non-empty file counts as the log). Probe: a repo source file as the log gave PASS.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed

findings.finding: Timeouts crash the run on Windows: the killed shell leaves a child process in the worktree, cleanup throws EPERM, no report is written, the CLI exits 1 (the FAIL code) and a stale report.md from an earlier run can remain.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed

findings.finding: The Jev payload can leak secrets: the failure signature is sent unredacted (only the excerpt is redacted) and redact() misses JSON-style values and Bearer tokens; the signature also lands in jev-shadow.jsonl and report.md. SKILL.md says secrets are redacted.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed. Not exercised here: the measured failure text holds no secret.

findings.finding: A timeout becomes BLOCKED (environment) because ETIMEDOUT matches the environment signature; 'permission denied' inside assertion output also downgrades FAIL to BLOCKED. Never a false PASS.
Any path containing an api/ folder is a 'contract', so two stories editing an ordinary file under src/api/ get FAIL instead of REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Attribution matches bare basenames as substrings ('api', 'index', 'a'), so unrelated stories are blamed (in measured case c5, S1 is blamed only because 'api' appears in 'ok api.test.js').
Only the later story in a merge conflict gets FAIL; the earlier one can stay PASS if the diff lists do not overlap.

Side effects on the real repository: batch commands run with shell and the full environment (incl. OPENROUTER_API_KEY), git worktree add and merges run in the real repo (hooks run, objects added); SKILL.md does not warn.
SKILL.md points to a design plan at F:\Download\..., unreadable for others.
Jev coupling is clean: finalize() never reads cl.jev, decide() never throws, a missing key or timeout ends as cl.jev.error.
MEASUREMENT: the answer key could be reached from arm A's folder (../../gold.json, B prompts, B logs, sibling B report), and the --forbid check would not catch it.
findings.resolution: fixed: gold, prompts, pristine fixtures and B logs now live in a private folder outside the work-folder parent; collect.mjs --forbid also counts A tool calls that mention gold.json, _logs, _verifier-out, .B.r<n> or -private (sibling B work folders stay reachable, hence the mechanical check)

findings.finding: MEASUREMENT: gold and case choice depend on the tool: 5 of 6 cases come from the tool's own fixtures, the tool was run against gold before the measurement and c3 was rebuilt when it disagreed; B is nearly guaranteed a perfect score and the 2-story cases are easy.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed; recorded in deviations. Cases are the ones the brief asked for (tool fixtures plus variants); a harder, tool-independent set is the next step.

findings.finding: MEASUREMENT: the shared prompt hands arm A the tool's rules almost word for word, so the run measures carrying out the rules, not knowing them.
findings.resolution: accepted by the user for this run (2026-10-18), not fixed; statuses need definitions for gold to be scorable; recorded in deviations.

findings.finding: MEASUREMENT: c3 gold is debatable (recorded exit 1 but committed code is green).
findings.resolution: open: kept; the prompt says a PASS needs every required check recorded with exit code 0. A wrong c3 answer in either arm is read with that in mind.

findings.resolution: fixed: grade.mjs and collect.mjs added to the experiment folder; Node 24 is what runs the experiment
